video_title: Hornets vs Grizzlies: Christian Anderson Jr. Postgame Media Availability | 11/23/2026

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on building confidence through team and coaching support
quotes.excerpt: the more my teammates and my coaches build me up, the more comfortable I feel out there
quotes.quote: I think it's just playing with more confidence and the more my teammates and my coaches build me up, the more comfortable I feel out there. Every game by game it just feels better as the season goes on, so I just stay confident. I think it's the main thing.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr says his recent play is about playing with more confidence and leaning on his teammates and coaches to stay comfortable on the floor.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. discusses how support from his teammates and coaches helps him maintain confidence during his postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on maintaining mental focus and trusting his process
quotes.excerpt: I don't let influence how I play and I try not to let it wear on my confidence
quotes.quote: Just being able to trust my work, trust my process and believe in everything I've done up to this point. A couple bad games, I don't let influence how I play and I try not to let it wear on my confidence. Some that I think I've been working on is just staying mentally focused while I'm out there and just to be prepared when my name is called.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr on his mental approach to the season: I try to trust my work and my process and not let a couple bad games influence how I play.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. explains his mental approach to staying focused and trusting his process after experiencing a few poor shooting performances.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on the Hornets' long-term outlook and team growth
quotes.excerpt: we don't let it drain our confidence and we still think we can go out there
quotes.quote: It's a long season and obviously you're playing against some of the best players in the world and you can't let five games try to let you down mentally and wear on what you're trying to get accomplished. It's 82 games so you got a lot of time to build back up even if you lose a lot of games early. We don't let it drain our confidence and we still think we can go out there and we think we're getting better each game.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr on the Hornets early season struggles: It is 82 games so you have a lot of time to build back up even if you lose a lot of games early.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. reflects on the long NBA season and the importance of maintaining team confidence despite early losses.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his preparation and shooting confidence
quotes.excerpt: not trying to second thing, not trying to play too correct, I feel like
quotes.quote: Just being ready when my name is called, preparation and then just being confident when I shoot the ball. Not trying to second thing, not trying to play too correct, I feel like. I think I was thinking too much and I guess the less you think, the more you can actually focus on making shots.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr on his shooting slump: I think I was thinking too much and I guess the less you think the more you can actually focus on making shots.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. discusses his preparation and the need to play instinctively rather than overthinking his shots.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on the mentorship from Ryan Frazier and veterans
quotes.excerpt: Ryan Frazier helps me a ton, you know, just court work wise and film wise
quotes.quote: I would say the whole team, the whole coaching staff, but Ryan Frazier helps me a ton, you know, just court work wise and film wise. Then my vets, all my teammates, they've been trying to push me to stay confident in the preparation and defensively, all that stuff. I feel like they've done a really good job of trying to build me up.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr credits Ryan Frazier and the Hornets veterans for helping him stay confident in his preparation and defensive work.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. credits Ryan Frazier and his veteran teammates for their mentorship and efforts to build his confidence.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on the benefits of early-season challenges
quotes.excerpt: getting just thrown into the fire early and being able to play a lot of the better defenders
quotes.quote: Getting just thrown into the fire early and being able to play a lot of the better defenders early on, I felt like just being able to struggle and then being able to make adjustments early in the season and be prepared when we play them next time. Development wise, I feel like it was really good for me and helped me a lot just being able to understand what I need to do better to handle pressure like that.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr says getting thrown into the fire early against elite defenders has been a key part of his development this season.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. discusses how facing tough defenders early in the season has aided his professional development.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on his defensive mindset and physical play
quotes.excerpt: just trying to be as physical as I can, especially with these bodies out here
quotes.quote: I feel like it's just a competitive thing and a one-two and a will factor. Just trying to be as physical as I can, especially with these bodies out here. Just trying to do all I can, even though it might be mismatches, just make it as hard as possible for them to catch the ball or score.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr on his defensive mindset: I am just trying to be as physical as I can and make it as hard as possible for them to catch the ball or score.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. describes his defensive mindset and the importance of playing with physicality against larger opponents.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on using his size to his advantage defensively
quotes.excerpt: get low, get into, you know, taller defenders' legs
quotes.quote: I mean just to use your size to your advantage, like get low, get into, you know, taller defenders' legs. I feel like that's the main thing that works best for me.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr on defending taller players: I try to use my size to my advantage by getting low and getting into their legs.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. explains the tactical advantage of using his size to get low and disrupt taller defenders.

quotes.speaker: Christian Anderson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Christian Anderson Jr. on exploiting tunnel vision in bigger defenders
quotes.excerpt: I think it can be an advantage if you play it the right way
quotes.quote: I think it can be an advantage if you play it the right way and if you scrap the right way and have the right mentality to make them catch it, not close to the basket and be as swizz as you can and make it as hard as you can for them to get into the offense. If you play it the right way, I think you can definitely be a sort of advantage.
quotes.social_post: Christian Anderson Jr says playing with the right mentality can turn a size disadvantage into an advantage if you make it hard for opponents to get into their offense.

structured.context: Christian Anderson Jr. discusses how playing with the right defensive mentality can turn his size into an advantage against bigger players.
